unreg:overtime_periods.blueprint_mechanism: Points = possessions x efficiency for each team; possessions come from both teams' tempo with a control effect, efficiency from opponent-adjusted offense/defense with shooting-luck regression and free-throw volume. Late-half and late-game fouling and OT add tail mass, and availability of key scorers or ball handlers alters pace and efficiency.

unreg:race_to_n_points.blueprint_mechanism: Margin follows opponent-adjusted efficiency and tempo, shifted by home court, neutral-site and travel effects and, importantly, by who plays. CBB ratings are noisier than NBA ratings (fewer games, roster churn), so uncertainty and market-implied information matter, and variance depends on tempo and three-point reliance. Disclosure of availability is sparse, so edge lies in scenario mixtures and rating uncertainty.
